label: Joint-absence power scope controls, by finite models (inference)
rule: Evaluate the three-world, replacement and non-Euclidean frames under the possibility reading and a maximally specific power
meaning: Nonvacuity applies actualAbsencePowerOfTotal on the three-world frame. In the replacement frame the actual contingent c is absent at true while d is contingent there, so total absence fails at both worlds. In the non-Euclidean frame the only accessible total-absence world b keeps g and c (necessary relative to b), and the only world lacking them, c, lacks g. In the three-world frame the maximally specific power holds for total absence (true only at none) but not for actual absence (true at some true too).
